title: Decision tree and DNF agreement
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $A$ be a set of available coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, and let $T$ be a decision tree whose queries use available coordinates and whose leaves return signs. Then the Boolean function on the sign cube computed by the DNF formula associated with $T$ equals the function obtained by evaluating $T$ on the corresponding binary input, with each binary coordinate encoded as a sign.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
$T$ is a decision tree indexed by $A$ with sign-valued leaves
